description: HeatPro is a CEA-Liten Python package for constructing representative district-heating demand profiles. It disaggregates annual or monthly heat quantities into hourly demand using an external-temperature series, with associated network supply and return temperatures. Inputs are aggregate loads, weather and profile assumptions; outputs provide time-resolved boundary conditions for production-plant simulations. Coverage is globally configurable at network or building-demand scale, with a user-selected year or other input period. Public package source, installation instructions and online documentation are free under CeCILL-B. A limitation is that disaggregation creates representative profiles, not recovering measured hourly behaviour. Their suitability depends on weather, building mix and temporal assumptions. The README describes applications to power-to-heat, biomass, storage and representation of heating networks in Antares, with linked 2019 and 2022 Energy papers. HeatPro can prepare demand for energy-system and flexibility simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa). The documentation also advertises cooling-demand functions that were not evaluated here. No temperature series, demand files or application code was downloaded.
